scenario: [LTIM.2.6.2]: the compiler counts `t.local(tz)` as a zone read unless `tz` folds to `"UTC"`, and a designation it cannot fold counts whatever it holds. `a.zone` is a `String` slot, so `e.fired.local(a.zone)` may name any zone when the rule runs ([LTIM.10.8]): the `where` is time-dependent ([LTIM.2.4.1]) and, on a rule with two positive patterns, DS_VALIDATE_NOW_MULTIPATTERN_UNSUPPORTED. The program is LTIM.2.6.2_const_utc_zone_multipattern_compiles with the `const` replaced by a slot; LTIM.2.6.2_zone_read_multipattern_rejects pins a literal zone that is not `"UTC"`. PATH: `dsc.validate.ltim_2_6_2_clock_where`'s `time_read`, whose zone arm is `dsc.typecheck.ltim_2_4_1_zone_read`; `dsc.dstest.ltsl_4_1_string_constant` does not fold a slot read, so the arm counts it.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Arm scope logical:
    k: Int key
    zone: String mutable

schema Event scope logical:
    k: Int key
    fired: Time mutable

rule office_hours:
    Arm a
    Event e where e.k == a.k and e.fired.local(a.zone).hour > 8
->
    log info "in hours"
